Ideally, predictions would adaptively select or combine the most relevant reference examples for each test input. This creates a basic tension in the one-shot setting: predictive performance benefits from reusing all labeled examples, while conformal calibration restricts such reuse. We resolve this tension with Conformal Aggregation of One-Shot Predictors ( CAOS ), a conformal framework that aggregates one-shot predictors while allowing all labeled examples to participate in calibration.
